marketSignals.signal: Giftable soap bundles and seasonal scent sets are easier to understand than one-off bars.
Process videos, cutting videos, ingredient closeups, and sink-side styling photos perform better than plain product shots.
marketSignals.priceRange: $12-$18 per premium bar when packaged as small-batch or botanical

marketSignals.signal: Simple starter collections convert better than huge scent menus. Three products are enough for launch.

competitors.name: Wild Fern Soap Studio
competitors.positioning: Botanical cold-process soaps with rustic gift packaging.
competitors.whatWorks: Clear ingredient story and earthy visual identity.
competitors.gap: Feels outdoorsy but not especially modern or sink-styled.

competitors.name: Sunday Lather Co.
competitors.positioning: Soft pastel soaps for gifts and self-care routines.
competitors.whatWorks: Strong gift angle and polished product names.
competitors.gap: Could feel too precious for everyday use.

competitors.name: Plain Good Goods
competitors.positioning: Minimal fragrance-free and low-scent bars for sensitive skin.
competitors.gap: Low emotional pull; not very giftable.

gaps: Quietly giftable soap: attractive enough to give, practical enough to use every day.
Low-crowd shelf: fewer scents, clearer choice, no overwhelming menu.
Sink-side design: products merchandised as part of a calm bathroom or kitchen ritual.
Founder-made proof: process clips and batch notes can build trust without expensive ads.

launchProducts.name: Lavender Oat Bar
launchProducts.notes: Oat milk, lavender, and a creamy lather for sensitive-feeling skin.

launchProducts.name: Citrus Clay Bar
launchProducts.notes: Orange peel, kaolin clay, and a clean scent that does not smell like cleaner.

launchProducts.name: Cedar Mint Bar
launchProducts.notes: Cedar, mint, and charcoal for a sharper, cooler shower bar.

channels.name: Landing page
channels.purpose: Collect emails and test which product angle gets clicks before opening a shop.

channels.name: Instagram Reels
channels.purpose: Show making, cutting, wrapping, and sink styling. Use one post per product.

channels.name: Etsy
channels.purpose: Use after the email list and product names are ready; start with one starter trio listing.

weekOneActions: Pick the brand name and reserve matching handles.
Make or photograph three prototype bars in consistent light.
Publish the landing page and ask 20 friends to pick a favorite product.
Post three process clips: mixing, cutting, wrapping.
Set up a simple email list export from the landing page responses.
Price the starter trio and decide whether shipping is included.
Write the first Etsy listing draft, but do not open the shop until product photos are ready.
